scene.topic_description:
Situation: After discussing your background, the interviewer moves to the key decision points of the interview. This is where they judge your fit for the role, your practical ability, and your availability, and where you need to understand what happens after the meeting.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: giving your name, naming the position, describing previous workplaces and duties, discussing salary.
must_say: say why you want this job — slot: the reason
say what you do well at work — slot: the skill
answer whether you can do a task — slot: the task
answer whether you can start on a date — slot: the date
ask whether training is provided — slot: none
ask what the next step is — slot: none
confirm you are interested in the job — slot: the position
must_understand: asks why you want this job
asks what you are good at and whether you can do a task
tells you the next step after the interview

the definition «training for a job» of «instruire» reads as en, not ro (for)
the definition «the next action in a process» of «următorul pas» reads as en, not ro (the)
the definition «at work» of «la serviciu» reads as en, not ro (at)

TOPIC: Основные вопросы

TOPIC_DESCRIPTION: Situation: After discussing your background, the interviewer moves to the key decision points of the interview. This is where they judge your fit for the role, your practical ability, and your availability, and where you need to understand what happens after the meeting.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: giving your name, naming the position, describing previous workplaces and duties, discussing salary.

About the learner, in their own words: Собеседование в пятницу, боюсь вопросов про опыт

SURVIVAL_SET:
must_say:
1. say why you want this job — slot: the reason
2. say what you do well at work — slot: the skill
3. answer whether you can do a task — slot: the task
4. answer whether you can start on a date — slot: the date
5. ask whether training is provided — slot: none
6. ask what the next step is — slot: none
7. confirm you are interested in the job — slot: the position
must_understand:
1. asks why you want this job
2. asks what you are good at and whether you can do a task
3. asks when you can start
4. explains whether training is provided
5. tells you the next step after the interview

TARGET_LANGUAGE: Romanian

NATIVE_LANGUAGE: Russian

LEVEL: Beginner

LEARNER_GENDER: unknown

LEARNER_ROLE: Candidat / Кандидат

PARTNER_ROLE: Intervievator / Интервьюер

VOCABULARY_COUNT: 8–12

EARLIER_DAYS:
none

topic.description_target: Veți exersa cum să explicați motivația și abilitățile, să răspundeți despre sarcini și disponibilitate și să întrebați despre instruire și pașii următori.
topic.description_native: Вы потренируетесь объяснять мотивацию и навыки, отвечать о задачах и доступности, а также спрашивать об обучении и следующих шагах.

partner_lines.text_target: De ce doriți acest loc de muncă?

partner_lines.text_native: Что вы хорошо умеете делать на работе?

partner_lines.text_target: Da, oferim instruire în prima săptămână.
partner_lines.text_native: Да, мы проводим обучение в первую неделю.

partner_lines.text_target: Următorul pas este un test scurt online.

vocabulary.image_prompt: A person speaking with an interviewer in a modern office
A trainer showing a new employee how to use office equipment

vocabulary.definition_target: the next action in a process

vocabulary.image_prompt: An employee working at a desk in an office
